proof_summary: Let \(Q_n+P_n\sqrt2=(1+\sqrt2)^n\), so \(Q_n^2-2P_n^2=(-1)^n\); Pell-approximation bounds give the no-carry identity \(\lfloor\sqrt2(P_n+j)\rfloor=Q_n+\lfloor\sqrt2j\rfloor\) for \(1\le j\le Q_n\), making each shifted sign block a copy of the initial block with a parity-determined sign. Splitting into these blocks and inducting yields the exact values \(a(P_{2k})=2k\) (and \(a(P_{2k+1})=1\)), from which arbitrarily large values follow.
